capabilities: Restyles the whole Obsidian interface with glass panels and soft colors
Draws the vault as a neural graph, 3D organism, space scene or single neuron
Skins the built-in graph view and canvases
Adds a start screen, daily journal header and investigation case board
Reads Claude Code and Codex project histories into linked neurons
disambiguation: Not a plant or gardening tool; the name refers to the organic, living-tissue look it gives the app.
extras: AI projects is desktop-only and reads Claude Code and Codex histories outside the vault only after Sync; the graph and canvas skins hook into Obsidian internals and fall back to the original views if an update breaks them; the plugin makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: The built-in graph, drawn as neurons
problem: Obsidian's default interface and its graph and canvas views look flat, with no built-in way to see the vault as a living, explorable overview.

relations.evidence: Press Sync: your Claude Code and Codex projects grow into neurons
Flora reads their histories on your computer, finds every project you built with them

summary: Visual overhaul that restyles Obsidian with glass panels and adds neural graph, 3D, space and neuron views, wallpapers, a journal and a case board.
